messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
To compare our Wireless Communication signaling / non-signaling tester solution with a competitor without unsupported claims, use our formal R&S specifications / features documents for R&S capabilities, competitor official datasheets / release notes / option catalogs for competitor capabilities, and documented test conditions, option codes, software versions, conformance reports, and TCO calculations for any numerical or superiority claim. [9][15][18][59][100]
### Required evidence
| Claim type | Evidence required before using it |
|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 signaling / network-emulation capability | Use CMX500 formal Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32; CMX500 is documented as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD, while the features document covers signaling / application / measurement options but is not a technical specifications datasheet. [40][59][93] |
| CMX500 WLAN / NR / LTE signaling options | Cite the CMX500 Features and Functions option tables for the exact option codes and functions, such as WLAN signaling options CMX-KS350B to CMX-KS357B, WLAN 2x2 MIMO CMX-KS360B, LTE signaling CMX-KS500B/M/X, NR signaling CMX-KS600B/M/X, and further NR extensions. [27][60][62] |
| CMX500 fading, application, IP, audio or test-scenario capability | Cite the CMX500 Features and Functions option tables for exact option codes such as CMX-KE500 / KE600 fading, CMX-KC550B / KC660B / KC661B / KC665B RF test scenarios, and CMX-KA100 / KA110 / KA150 / KA180 / KA181 / KA401 application, IP analysis and audio options. [94] |
| R&S non-signaling / production tester capability | Use the specific formal product sources for each platform: CMP180 documents cover production / wireless communication device testing, multiport RF generator/analyzer architecture and measurement options; CMP200 specifications describe a 5G NR FR2 mmWave non-signaling one-box test solution; CMW100 K06 specifications describe a Communications Manufacturing Test Set with RF generator/analyzer, power meter, spectrum analyzer and wireless production test specifications. [5][43][47] |
| Binding R&S numerical specifications | Use specifications with limits from the relevant specifications document, because CMX500 product data distinguishes warranted specifications from non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values and measured values, and states that data without tolerance limits is not binding. [40][59] |
| Competitor capability claims | Use competitor official datasheets, release notes, option catalogs, configuration guides, support terms or third-party evidence, because the R&S battle-card pages state that Keysight, Anritsu and amarisoft claims currently need official or third-party confirmation before customer use. [9][15][18][100] |
| Competitor frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option or software claims | Provide the competitor’s official document, option code, software version and test conditions, because the passages flag Anritsu FR2 frequency, FR2 bandwidth, data rate, FR1 bandwidth, FR3 module and RF board claims as unsupported without Anritsu official specifications and conditions. [86][89] |
| Keysight UXM comparison claims | Provide Keysight official documentation with model numbers, document numbers, versions, order numbers and dates, because the Keysight battle card lacks official Keysight documentation for E7515P, E7515W, E7515B, E7515E and E7515R. [10] |
| Amarisoft comparison claims | Provide amarisoft official documentation or third-party sources for product capability, support, Wi-Fi signaling, production / ATE limits, UE counts and NTN / RedCap / NB-IoT / LTE-M claims, because the amarisoft page says all such information currently comes from an R&S internal battle card and lacks official confirmation. [18][51] |
| Conformance or validation claims | Provide validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB / GCF or other certification evidence, because the Keysight comparison lacks a Samsung validation report, test case list, PTCRB RFT 555 version or date, and the amarisoft comparison lacks test package option codes or accreditation documents. [10][69][84] |
| “Only platform,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or similar superiority language | Do not use these as technical facts unless formal evidence is available, because the passages identify those phrases as sales language rather than verifiable specifications. [9][15][18][76] |
| TCO, calibration cost, license-count or price claims | Provide a TCO formula, price basis, license counts, calibration assumptions and formal commercial evidence, because the Anritsu battle card does not list pricing, trade-in, TCO calculation basis, license quantity or calibration cost assumptions, and the Anritsu offensive-play page says lower-TCO messaging lacks a TCO formula. [79][86] |
| FR3 / RFU18 roadmap claims | Do not treat RFU18 / FR3 roadmap numbers as binding specifications without formal RFU18 order number, specifications document, release date and supported configurations, because the FR3 / RFU18 page says these are missing and that some demo evidence is only PR / demonstration-level evidence. [102] |
### Practical rule
A safe comparison should cite R&S formal specifications / features for our signaling and non-signaling products, cite competitor official or third-party sources for competitor capabilities, and avoid turning internal battle-card positioning into customer-facing technical facts. [7][13][16][59][100]

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › 文件依據與版本
本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight

### Short answer
To compare our Wireless Communication signaling / non-signaling tester solution with a competitor without unsupported claims, use our formal R&S specifications / features documents for R&S capabilities, competitor official datasheets / release notes / option catalogs for competitor capabilities, and documented test conditions, option codes, software versions, conformance reports, and TCO calculations for any numerical or superiority claim. [9][15][18][59][100]
### Required evidence
| Claim type | Evidence required before using it |
|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 signaling / network-emulation capability | Use CMX500 formal Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32; CMX500 is documented as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD, while the features document covers signaling / application / measurement options but is not a technical specifications datasheet. [40][59][93] |
| CMX500 WLAN / NR / LTE signaling options | Cite the CMX500 Features and Functions option tables for the exact option codes and functions, such as WLAN signaling options CMX-KS350B to CMX-KS357B, WLAN 2x2 MIMO CMX-KS360B, LTE signaling CMX-KS500B/M/X, NR signaling CMX-KS600B/M/X, and further NR extensions. [27][60][62] |
| CMX500 fading, application, IP, audio or test-scenario capability | Cite the CMX500 Features and Functions option tables for exact option codes such as CMX-KE500 / KE600 fading, CMX-KC550B / KC660B / KC661B / KC665B RF test scenarios, and CMX-KA100 / KA110 / KA150 / KA180 / KA181 / KA401 application, IP analysis and audio options. [94] |
| R&S non-signaling / production tester capability | Use the specific formal product sources for each platform: CMP180 documents cover production / wireless communication device testing, multiport RF generator/analyzer architecture and measurement options; CMP200 specifications describe a 5G NR FR2 mmWave non-signaling one-box test solution; CMW100 K06 specifications describe a Communications Manufacturing Test Set with RF generator/analyzer, power meter, spectrum analyzer and wireless production test specifications. [5][43][47] |
| Binding R&S numerical specifications | Use specifications with limits from the relevant specifications document, because CMX500 product data distinguishes warranted specifications from non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values and measured values, and states that data without tolerance limits is not binding. [40][59] |
| Competitor capability claims | Use competitor official datasheets, release notes, option catalogs, configuration guides, support terms or third-party evidence, because the R&S battle-card pages state that Keysight, Anritsu and amarisoft claims currently need official or third-party confirmation before customer use. [9][15][18][100] |
| Competitor frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option or software claims | Provide the competitor’s official document, option code, software version and test conditions, because the passages flag Anritsu FR2 frequency, FR2 bandwidth, data rate, FR1 bandwidth, FR3 module and RF board claims as unsupported without Anritsu official specifications and conditions. [86][89] |
| Keysight UXM comparison claims | Provide Keysight official documentation with model numbers, document numbers, versions, order numbers and dates, because the Keysight battle card lacks official Keysight documentation for E7515P, E7515W, E7515B, E7515E and E7515R. [10] |
| Amarisoft comparison claims | Provide amarisoft official documentation or third-party sources for product capability, support, Wi-Fi signaling, production / ATE limits, UE counts and NTN / RedCap / NB-IoT / LTE-M claims, because the amarisoft page says all such information currently comes from an R&S internal battle card and lacks official confirmation. [18][51] |
| Conformance or validation claims | Provide validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB / GCF or other certification evidence, because the Keysight comparison lacks a Samsung validation report, test case list, PTCRB RFT 555 version or date, and the amarisoft comparison lacks test package option codes or accreditation documents. [10][69][84] |
| “Only platform,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or similar superiority language | Do not use these as technical facts unless formal evidence is available, because the passages identify those phrases as sales language rather than verifiable specifications. [9][15][18][76] |
| TCO, calibration cost, license-count or price claims | Provide a TCO formula, price basis, license counts, calibration assumptions and formal commercial evidence, because the Anritsu battle card does not list pricing, trade-in, TCO calculation basis, license quantity or calibration cost assumptions, and the Anritsu offensive-play page says lower-TCO messaging lacks a TCO formula. [79][86] |
| FR3 / RFU18 roadmap claims | Do not treat RFU18 / FR3 roadmap numbers as binding specifications without formal RFU18 order number, specifications document, release date and supported configurations, because the FR3 / RFU18 page says these are missing and that some demo evidence is only PR / demonstration-level evidence. [102] |
### Practical rule
A safe comparison should cite R&S formal specifications / features for our signaling and non-signaling products, cite competitor official or third-party sources for competitor capabilities, and avoid turning internal battle-card positioning into customer-facing technical facts. [7][13][16][59][100]
